title: Planning a birthday party
instructions: Emily ve Josh anneleri için doğum günü partisi planlıyor. Fikir değişikliklerine dikkat et.

script.speaker: emily
script.text: Josh, it's Mum's birthday next Saturday. Let's have a party for her.

script.speaker: emily
script.text: No, our flat is too small. Let's have it at Aunt Rose's house. She has a big garden.

script.speaker: emily
script.text: About twenty. I can make a chocolate cake.

script.speaker: josh
script.text: Mum doesn't like chocolate. Make a lemon cake.

script.speaker: emily
script.text: Oh yes, you're right. And you can buy the drinks.

script.speaker: josh
script.text: No problem. What about a present?

script.speaker: emily
script.text: Mum loves books. Let's buy her a cookbook.

questions.feedback: Doğum günü annelerinin (Mum's birthday). Rose teyze partinin yapılacağı evin sahibi.

questions.prompt: Where is the party going to be?
questions.feedback: Evleri çok küçük (too small), parti Rose teyzenin evinde olacak.
questions.evidence: Let's have it at Aunt Rose's house.

questions.prompt: What cake is Emily going to make?
questions.feedback: Emily önce çikolatalı der ama anneleri çikolata sevmiyor. Limonlu (lemon) pasta yapacak.

questions.prompt: What present are they going to buy?
questions.feedback: Anneleri kitap seviyor; yemek kitabı (cookbook) alacaklar.
